newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait share index rises, trade eases in week.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait share index rises, trade eases in week.

text.p: Kuwait's share index rose 8.1 points to 2,210.4 in the week to Wednesday in easier trade as the market continued a slight correction that started last week following considerable rises in previous weeks, dealers said on Thursday.
"Dealers are cautious. They are trading selective shares after last week's fall," said a private dealer.
"It is best to play safe after a fall," said another.

The daily average for value of traded shares fell to 35.4 million dinars ($117 million) from 50.9 million. Volume eased to a daily average of 154 million shares from 190 million, figures released by the Kuwait Stock Exchange on Thursday show.
The index and trade levels registered a chain of peaks in the first quarter of 1997 with capital flows from abroad to invest in listed firms that showed profit increases in 1996.
Twenty-one shares fell, 20 rose and 19 were non-movers.
Real estate firms were the most active sector in terms of traded value with 63 million dinars, followed by investment firms with 57 million and banks with 22 million.
United Realty, National Bank, Kuwait Real Estate, Investment Projects, Pearl of Kuwait Real Estate and Securities Group were among the most active shares.
Only nationals of Gulf Arab states -- Saudi Arabia, Bahrain, United Arab Emirates, Qatar, Oman and Kuwait -- can trade on the exchange. Foreign residents can invest in mutual funds.
